description: This source file defines the class TransactionBenchmark, which is used for benchmarking Orleans transaction performance with various configurations (Memory, Azure, Throttling). It also includes nested configurator classes for setting up specific silo configurations.

classes.name: TransactionBenchmark
classes.description: Main class for setting up and executing transaction performance benchmarks across different silo configurations.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a silo to use in-memory grain storage.

classes.name: SiloAzureStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a silo to use Azure table transactional storage.

classes.name: SiloTransactionThrottlingConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a silo with transaction rate load shedding (throttling).

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Holds transaction benchmarking results, such as succeeded, failed, throttled counts, and elapsed time.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Set up a test cluster with in-memory storage.

methods.name: MemoryThrottledSetup
methods.description: Set up a test cluster with in-memory storage and throttling configurator.

methods.name: AzureSetup
methods.description: Set up a test cluster with Azure storage.

methods.name: AzureThrottledSetup
methods.description: Set up a test cluster with Azure storage and throttling configurator.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Performs a series of benchmark runs with warmup and iterations, then reports results.

methods.name: FullRunAsync
methods.description: Executes a full benchmarking run, aggregating reports.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Runs a single load and retrieves its report.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.
